operatingPolicy: No old job becomes PASSED or overwritten. Retain every first/partial outcome and immutable envelope.

New hypotheses are source-only, not fabricated runnable contracts; actual work needs exact inputs/oracle/resources and grant.
Preserve aged fairness of READY runnable jobs, at most3heavy systemwide and one canonical vector queue,50GBhard/46GBoperational owned storage. No blanket all-heavy serial performance rule.
Shared mechanisms may qualify sibling query paths independently while sharing a physical foundation; do not claim universal native/Datalog equivalence.

A native-backed assertion-view helper is its own declared SDK entrypoint, not Datalog-translator semantic or performance acceptance. Charge its native queries and decoding; sibling query paths require their own qualification.
